gloss: backward bend; reverse warp; back bow

definitions.gloss: backward bend; reverse warp; back bow
definitions.explanation: A bending or warping in the opposite direction from what is expected or normal. Used in construction, woodworking, and manufacturing to describe material that curves the wrong way, as well as in physical contexts to describe bending the body backward.

examples.english: The board developed a reverse warp.

examples.japanese: ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{木材|もくざい}→木材：13017_mokuzai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{逆反|ぎゃくぞ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}こり→起こる：01910_okoru⟧やすい。
examples.english: As drying progresses, reverse warping is more likely to occur in lumber.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体操|たいそう}{選手|せんしゅ}→体操選手：25172_taisousenshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{逆反|ぎゃくぞ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: The gymnast struck an impressive backward-arching pose.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧ (reverse, opposite) and {反|そ}り (warp, bend, curve). The {反|そ}り undergoes rendaku (voicing) to become ぞり. This term is used across several domains: in woodworking and construction, it describes unwanted warping of materials in the wrong direction; in physical activity, it describes arching the body backward.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逆反|ぎゃくぞ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent reverse warping
- {逆反|ぎゃくぞ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|しょう}じる→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧: reverse warping occurs
- {逆反|ぎゃくぞ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{修正|しゅうせい}→修正：03210_shuusei⟧: correction of reverse warp

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {反|そ}り: warp, bend — warping in any direction
- ⟦{反|そ}り{返|かえ}り→反り返る：16769_sorikaeru⟧: arching backward — specifically the physical motion of bending back
- ⟦{歪|ゆが}み→歪み：09409_yugami⟧: distortion, warping — a broader term for any deformation
